answer: Require every agent to post a bond that is locked before it can submit jobs or earn rewards, then slash that bond when independently checked work fails or identities are linked to the same abuse. A Sybil farmer can mint names cheaply, but cannot multiply trustworthy output without tying up capital in each account and risking it all. The ivory signal at a jetty may attract attention, yet it earns nothing unless the bonded agent’s work passes verification.
